index.html.summary: KYS.Library.Zip Documentation Welcome to KYS.Library.Zip, an add-on to KYS.Library for creating and extracting zip archives in internal .NET applications. It zips in-memory file contents (optionally password-protected) and extracts zip files to a directory, loading the extracted items back for further use. This site contains a high-level overview of the library and a full API reference automatically generated from XML documentation comments. 📦 Project Modules KYS.Library.Zip Contains the shared model: ZipFileItem – a file entry (name and byte content) to be zipped, or one that was extracted from a zip file. KYS.Library.Zip.Services Contains the zip services: IZipCreator / ZipCreator – zips a list of ZipFileItem (with an optional password) into a byte[] (Zip) or saves it to a directory (ZipAndToFile). IZipExtractor / ZipExtractor – extracts a zip file (with an optional password) to a directory (Unzip) and exposes the extracted FileName and FileItems. Operations return a Result / Result<T> (CSharpFunctionalExtensions). ⚡ Quick Example using KYS.Library.Zip; using KYS.Library.Zip.Services; // Create a password-protected zip var creator = new ZipCreator( "documents", new List<ZipFileItem> { new() { Name = "readme.txt", Contents = File.ReadAllBytes("readme.txt") } }, password: "secret"); Result saved = creator.ZipAndToFile("output"); // Extract it again var extractor = new ZipExtractor { Password = "secret" }; Result unzipped = extractor.Unzip("output/documents.zip", "extracted"); 🚀 Using This Library (Internal Use) Since this library is not currently published to NuGet, it can be consumed by: Cloning or downloading the repository Building the solution Locating the generated DLLs under: KYS.Library.Zip/bin/Debug/net8.0/ or KYS.Library.Zip/bin/Release/net8.0/ Adding the DLL references to your project manually (KYS.Library.Zip depends on KYS.Library, so reference both): In Visual Studio: Project → Add Reference → Browse → Select DLLs In .NET CLI-based project: <ItemGroup> <Reference Include="KYS.Library"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.Library.dll</HintPath> </Reference> <Reference Include="KYS.Library.Zip"> <HintPath>path/to/KYS.Library.Zip.dll</HintPath> </Reference> </ItemGroup> Adding the third-party NuGet packages used by the library: SharpZipLib and CSharpFunctionalExtensions. 📘 API Reference Detailed class, method, and property documentation is available under the API section of this site. All content is generated automatically based on XML documentation comments in the source code. 📂 Project Structure KYS.Library.Zip/ ├── Models/ └── Services/ (Classes and namespaces inside each module can be viewed through the API reference.) 🛠 Documentation This documentation is generated using DocFX and will stay updated as new XML comments are added or modified.
